interpretation: P4AF clears the frozen synthetic severe-artifact controls and follows the derivative variance shape much more closely than constant variance or P4D. The no-fit direct LOD preserves means and bounded ACF error but underestimates area-mean variance and loses to the unscaled negative control, so it is rejected without coefficient or gate rescue.
branch_action: Retain P4AF only as a full-resolution generic synthetic reference. Close the area-inverse variance LOD. A subsequent leaf may derive a moment-aware variance scale from the fixed spatial covariance and area average before inspecting results.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic severe-artifact evidence for a full-resolution generic derivative-conditioned density approximation and negative direct-LOD evidence; not measured emulsion, photographic quality, stock response, calibration or product evidence.
